title: TroopConnect branch preset
description: The shape of a branch/section preset: the ladder a unit's sections are laid out in, and the sections to create with it. Read and validated by members/presets/__init__.py; described in docs/dev/CONTRACT.md. Only the subset of JSON Schema that module implements is used here: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, minLength, pattern, enum, minimum, maximum and local $ref.

title.description: Human-readable name of the layout, shown by `manage.py setup`.

source.description: Where the layout is documented, so a troop can check it against the federation's own description.

note.description: Anything a contributor wants to say about the layout.

branches.description: The branches, in the order the ladder runs.

key.description: Stable identifier for this branch, unique within the file. `promotes_to` refers to it, and `manage.py setup` stores it on the branch so re-running recognises it after a rename.

promotes_to.description: Key of the branch a member moves into when they outgrow this one. Null means the ladder stops here: a branch marked is_top graduates its members, any other leaves them flagged for review.

is_top.description: True for the branch members leave the ladder from. At least one branch must set it, and a branch that sets it must not set promotes_to.

sections.description: Sections to create inside this branch. A section is only ever created, never changed: a section a troop already has is left as it is.

sex.description: Who the section takes: M, F, or B for both. Defaults to B.

names.description: The name per language. French is required — it is the language modeltranslation falls back to, so a language left out reads as French.

age.description: Age on the troop's age reference day. Null means 'no limit', which is how a branch that keeps its members however old they get says so.
